描述_ZN: Scroll of Two Pheasants in a Snowy Landscape, Ming dynasty, painted by Lin Liang, on silk with color, 131 cm in length and 58 cm in width.　　Signed: "Lin Liang", with an illegible seal.　　The painting depicts two pheasants, one male and one female, resting on the edge of a snowy rock. The male bird has long tail feathers and richly colored plumage, which is a favorite subject for flower and bird painters.　　Lin Liang's painting does not focus on the beauty of the pheasant's feathers, but on the natural environment in which it grows. He uses heavy ink and swift strokes to paint the rocks and branches, while ink and water combine with light colors to paint the pheasant, which is strong and robust, but with a touch of artistry.
